sloka: विजयो मधुमत्तश्च काश्यपो मङ्गलः कुटः ।सुराजः कालियो भद्रो दन्तवक्रः सुमागधः ।। ७.४३.२ ॥
transliteration: vijayo madhumattaśca kāśyapo maṅgalaḥ kuṭaḥ ।surājaḥ kāliyo bhadro dantavakraḥ sumāgadhaḥ ।। 7.43.2 ॥

translations.english: These were the names of some of the attendees: Vijaya, Madhumatta, Kashyapa, Mangala, Kuta, Suraja, Kaliya, Bhadra, Dantavakra, and Sumagadha.
